items.title: Iranian State Hackers Use SSL.com Certificates to Sign Malware
items.description: Security researchers say multiple threat groups, including Iran's Charming Kitten APT offshoot Subtle Snail, are deploying malware with code-signing certificates from the Houston-based company.
